title: fix(i18n): the Console language menu offers the platform locale table's languages
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbQ445c6fbGTJdveorKb6FDj)_

Fixes #30514

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the published `objectstack-i18n` skill never says the Console menu offers a locale outside the platform table, and every `supportedLocales` example in it is a table language

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Console 右上角语言菜单只提供平台语言表（11 种）里的语言，并与应用声明的语言取交集。`zh-CN` 这类旧写法显示成表里的名字（简体中文），同一语言只出现一次，`th` 这类表外语言不再出现。
- **为什么改**：裁决 F 规定平台只有一张语言表、不分档。此前菜单把应用列表原样照搬：所有自带应用都显示「中文（中国）」，还会提供没有任何界面翻译的 `th`。
- **风险与回滚**：这是一次收窄，受影响的自带应用为 0 个（examples 三个应用和 HotCRM 只声明表内语言）。已存储 `th` 的用户会先以 `th` 启动，应用列表到达后自动回到默认语言。回滚只需 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx`（`offeredTableTags` 与自愈判断），`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/LocaleSwitcher.tsx`（勾选），`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ProfilePage.tsx`（存储值读法）。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/LocaleSwitcher.appLocales.test.tsx`，预期全部通过，其中 app-crm、app-todo、HotCRM 三种声明都显示表内名称。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（落地前席位需完成契约复审档复核）。

## What changes

`offerableLanguages` (the list the globe menu and the profile page's language card render) is now the platform locale table ∩ the app's locale list:

- each code the app lists (`GET /api/v1/i18n/locales`) is read through `resolveBuiltInLanguage`, which applies the table's read aliases and then shorter prefixes, the same resolution that picks the pack the code renders in;
- only codes that land on a table tag are kept, as that tag, de-duplicated, in the app's declared order;
- an app answer with no table language, or no `loadLocales` wiring, offers the table's 11 tags. An out-of-table key of `config.resources` no longer adds an entry to that fallback.

Around it:

- **Self-heal.** The `provisional` self-heal (a stored language accepted on the loader's credit) is judged against the offered set, not the raw app list. A stored `th` still boots, then reverts and is cleared once the list lands, even when the app lists `th`. The loader's credit and `BootstrapLocaleOptions.hasLoader` are unchanged (seat amendment 2, option C).
- **Checkmark.** `LocaleSwitcher` compares the session language through `resolveBuiltInLanguage`, so a session in `zh-CN` ticks 简体中文.
- **Profile page.** `ProfilePage` reads a stored `sys_user.locale` spelling as its table tag (`zh-CN` → `zh-Hans`). Without that, the exact-match check prepended a stray 中文（中国） option beside 简体中文. A tag the table does not name stays as stored.

### What the menu offered before, measured

Probe on `origin/main` c2bb879f: the real `I18nProvider` with a mocked `loadLocales`. Step-1 report: #30514 comment 6731426750.

| Case | `loadLocales()` answer | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 · no loader (control) | none | 11 table tags | unchanged |
| 2a · table tags | `en, zh-Hans` | English, 简体中文 | unchanged |
| 2b · app-crm, app-showcase | `en, zh-CN` | English, 中文（中国） | English, 简体中文 |
| 2c · app-todo | `en, zh-CN, ja-JP` | …, 日本語 (日本) | …, 日本語 |
| 2d · HotCRM sales | `en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES` | …, Español de España | …, Español |
| 3 · out-of-table | `en, zh-CN, th` | …, ไทย (no pack) | English, 简体中文 |
| 4a · alias beside its tag | `en, zh-CN, zh-Hans` | two entries for one pack | one 简体中文 |
| 4b · region variants | `de-AT, pt-PT, zh-TW, en-GB` | CLDR names (Português europeu served by `pt-BR`) | `de`, `pt-BR`, `zh-Hant`, `en` with table labels |
| 5 · app declares nothing | the loaded bundle set | 11 entries, mixed spellings | the 11 table tags |

### Narrowing census: 0 first-party apps affected

- `supportedLocales` declarations: examples/app-crm `['en', 'zh-CN']`, examples/app-showcase `['en', 'zh-CN']`, examples/app-todo `['en', 'zh-CN', 'ja-JP']`, HotCRM `src/sales/index.ts` `['en', 'zh-CN', 'ja-JP', 'es-ES']`. objectstack-ai/gallery declares none.
- None names a language outside the table, and no example or HotCRM translations file is keyed outside it.
- 0 in-repo producers pass `config.resources` to `I18nProvider` (`git grep` over `ui/apps`, `ui/packages`, `ui/examples`).

### Downstream readers of the offered tag

A pick now writes the table tag (`zh-Hans`). `zh-Hans` was already an offered value before this PR, in cases 1, 2a and 5. Each reader accepts it, measured:

- **The html lang attribute.** The provider writes `document.documentElement.lang = lng`, and the end-to-end pin's DOM shows `lang="zh-Hans"`.
- **The locale header the adapter sends.** `createAuthenticatedFetch` copies the html lang attribute into `Accept-Language`. Both i18n providers resolve a request locale with `resolveLocaleAmong`, and `resolveLocaleAmong('zh-Hans', [en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES, …])` = `zh-CN`, `ja` → `ja-JP`, `es` → `es-ES`.
- **What gets stored back to `sys_user.locale`.** The column's `locale_bcp47_shape` rule (`SYS_USER_LOCALE_TAG_PATTERN`) accepts `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant` and `pt-BR`. The messaging reader uses the same shape, and its bundle ladder is the same `resolveLocaleAmong`.

## Why

Ruling F (#29428, of #29349): the platform supports one list of languages, each complete on every surface, with no tiers. Phases 2 and 3 completed the Console packs and the server bundles for the table's 11 languages. This phase makes the menu offer exactly those languages.

## Tests

On `ui/` as of `bbc447f4`, from `ui/`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/LocaleSwitcher*`, `apps/console/src/pages/system/__tests__/ProfilePage*`: Test Files 107/107, Tests 1873 passed, 13 skipped.
- Consumers of the offered list (`app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/userLocale*`, `AppHeader*`, `studio-locale.i18n`, console `i18nAfterSignIn-12034`, `loadLocales*`, `FirstRunChecklist`, `HomeLayout.searchOpensPalette-12601`, `sharedInboxFeed.twoSurfaces`, plugin-form `affordanceGrantMap-12082`): 46 files. 45 were green; `userLocale-10059` went red as expected and is the edited pin below, and that file now passes 24/24.

New and rewritten pins:

- `LocaleSwitcher.appLocales.test.tsx`
  - `th` is not offered, whether it comes from the app list or from `config.resources`;
  - the app-crm / app-todo / HotCRM declarations show table labels, once each;
  - `zh-CN` beside `zh-Hans` is one entry;
  - a session stored as `zh-CN` ticks 简体中文.
- `provider-app-locale-restore.test.tsx`
  - a stored `th` boots, then reverts and is purged once the list lands;
  - a stored `zh-CN` stays and is offered as `zh-Hans`;
  - table ∩ app list as tags in app order; region variants;
  - the table fallback for an app listing no table language;
  - CONTROL: no loader offers the 11 table tags.
- `ProfilePage.language.test.tsx` (new top-level describe)
  - a stored `zh-CN` is one option with nothing to save;
  - a stored `th` is still shown.

Edited pin, approved by the seat: `userLocale-10059.test.tsx` "renders the offered variant for a bare column, end to end". A `zh` column with `loadLocales` `['en','zh-CN']` now shows `zh-Hans` (before: `zh-CN`). The offered entry is now the table tag; the pack is the same.

Ablation of the canonicalizing step (`offeredTableTags` pushes the raw code instead of its table tag), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`:

- the anchor went x1 → x0, and the blob went `c7299ca5` → `2551b42e`;
- 11 tests failed across `provider-app-locale-restore` and `LocaleSwitcher.appLocales` (Tests 11 failed, 22 passed);
- the restore left the blob equal to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Ruling F gaps outside this card**, carried on #29428 by the seat:
  - (a) the Studio namespace ships 2 of 11 languages, and `zh-Hant` resolves to the Simplified catalogue;
  - (b) the built-in emails ship 4 of 11 locales;
  - (c) `TranslationConfigSchema` accepts an out-of-table `supportedLocales` entry.

  This PR adds no language anywhere. It only removes entries.
- `localeLabel`'s `Intl.DisplayNames` branch is now reached only for a code outside the table, which the menu no longer offers. It is left in place: it is exported and still named by its own tests.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 36 commands. All 36 were run and exited 0, and `--ran` reconciles 36 derived / 36 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED. The PR-body gates (`check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`) ran against this body and exited 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` exited 0. The app-shell and console type-checks are left to CI's Type Check UI (they need the whole `ui/` closure built).
- Head `96d210d4` merges `origin/main`. The incoming commits touch no file in this diff, and `ui/` is unchanged since `bbc447f4`, where the suites above ran.
- The full dogfood battery is owed for the `(narrowing)` arm. It is running on `96d210d4`, and its reading goes in the os-dev-report on #30514.

- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
